subject: Marine works - Bridge Construction - Beauport to L'Isle-aux-Coudres - Orleans Island Bridge
text:
Marine works - Bridge Construction - Beauport to L'Isle-aux-Coudres - Orleans Island Bridge
Construction operations taking place 24 hours a day, 7 days a week 120 metres upstream from the Orleans Island bridge. Piles and private construction buoys temporarily established to mark the construction zones. Temporary jetties installed. Barges and boats on site.
Minimum wake requested.
